definition.note: No closed form is stored for this surface. It is defined by its shipped implementation in math_art.minsurf.parametric, which is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
sources: M. J. Callahan, D. Hoffman, W. H. Meeks III, "Embedded minimal surfaces with an infinite number of ends", Invent. Math. 96 (1989) 459-505;
M. Weber, https://minimalsurfaces.blog/ (Callahan-Hoffman-Meeks surfaces; the CHM-(1,1) notebook).

cross_checked.detail: 'It was the first genus 2 embedded doubly periodic minimal surface, adding a handle to one of the Karcher-Meeks-Rosenberg examples'; 4-ended (parallel annular ends inherited from KMR).
